Cybersecurity Services
What are cybersecurity services?
arrow_drop_down
Cybersecurity services are designed to protect individuals, organizations, and systems from cyber threats across scales. They include proactive and reactive strategies, assessments, and solution testing to help identify the most critical vulnerabilities, mitigate risks, and build resilient defenses against cyber threats.
How do cybersecurity services and cybersecurity technologies work together?
arrow_drop_down
Cybersecurity technology and services work together to create airtight defenses against cyber threats.
Where cybersecurity technology equips organizations with the capabilities to identify, map, and defend against threats, cybersecurity services provide professional expertise, strategy guidance, technology integration, risk assessment and evaluation, and continuous support in risk management.
How do I decide what cybersecurity services my organization requires?
arrow_drop_down
The services required depend on each organization’s specific needs and risk appetite. Factors also include critical steps like defining your goals, evaluating your current cybersecurity posture, and legal and compliance requirements, reviewing internal and external digital assets that require protection, budget allocation, and more.
If you need help understanding your requirements, reach out to our cybersecurity experts.
How can Group-IB cybersecurity services help prevent incidents?
arrow_drop_down
Group-IB cybersecurity services help organizations conduct timely tests, improve their systems, and reinstate the need to protect every layer of operation. Our range of robust assessments and testing solutions, our cybersecurity advisory services relating to areas such as compliance and configurations, and our training programs and courses help businesses strengthen their cybersecurity posture, mitigate risks, and prevent a wide range of cyber incidents.
How can Group-IB cybersecurity services help respond to incidents?
arrow_drop_down
Group-IB’s team of cybersecurity experts are truly first responders to cyber incidents. CERT-GIB offers 24/7 threat triaging and ensures the fastest possible takedown of violations, usually within hours. Our incident response team helps you assess intrusions, provide assistance on containment, and support your organization throughout the incident response lifecycle.
To investigate the root cause of incidents, our digital forensics team helps reconstruct the entire sequence of events, shares valuable information about the suspected perpetrators and provides digital evidence that complies with laws and regulations.
